_comment: On-screen hold windows {s,e} for the 10 comped cards in the user's pre-cut (cut == cards/sources/gibbsigg/Gibbsiggshort.mp4, 2160x3840, 57.45s). To retime a chip, shift BOTH s and e by the same delta.
